name: IRQ1_Expander71_Handler
evidence: Verified: flag 0x1fff8f8c, count 0x1fff8f98, disable IRQ1. Installed pointer 0x1f9dd at 0x1fff8044.

evidence: Verified: consume IRQ2 first, then IRQ0/1 when hardware ready. Re-enable each source after service.

name: PanelInputs_FirstSetBit16
evidence: Verified: scan bits 0-15 and return first set index or 16. Caller 0x1fa94.

name: IRQ6_FPGAEvent_Handler
evidence: Verified: sample event bits 0,1,2,3,5, update flag word and link state, clear hardware events.

name: Protocol_AdvanceHostHandshake
evidence: Verified: state 1 requires ten service increments and acknowledgement before state 2. Called under IRQ6 mask.

name: FPGA_ServiceDeferredEvents
evidence: Verified: disable IRQ6, service handshake/disconnect/events and at most eight messages, then enable IRQ6.

name: FPGA_GetEvent5ServiceCount
evidence: Verified: return 0x1fff8fb8. Foreground 0x1ff6c increments it for latched event bit 5.

name: SchedulerInitialize
evidence: Verified: clear callbacks and enabled fields in ten 16-byte slots, sample complemented counter.

name: SchedulerAddTimer
evidence: Verified: first free slot. Return index plus one or zero. No duplicate, callback, or period validation.

name: SchedulerRemoveTimer
evidence: Verified: accept handles 1-10, clear pointer and enabled flag, return one even for empty slot.

name: SchedulerService
evidence: Verified: one counter sample, 16-bit elapsed accumulation, synchronous call at 0x2033a, clear elapsed after return.

name: SchedulerCounter
evidence: Verified: complement Counter_ReadCounter and zero-extend 16-bit result at 0x20370.

name: SchedulerElapsed
evidence: Verified: unsigned 16-bit difference with extra decrement when now < start. Return ldrh at 0x203a8.

name: SettingsServiceSave
evidence: Verified: advance active save once. Independently start dirty save when elapsed >3000. No exclusion for active phase.

name: SettingsFinishActiveSave
evidence: Verified: 0x204e2 calls advance and 0x204e6 tests active. No dirty test or start call.

name: SettingsSaveSynchronously
evidence: Verified: shared descriptors, CRC and stream. Clear dirty but leave active phase and async descriptor cursor unchanged.

name: SettingsStartSave
evidence: Verified: build descriptors, write zero-CRC header and three descriptors, set active phase 1 and clear dirty.

name: SettingsSaveIsActive
evidence: Verified: return 0x1fff902c != 0.

name: SettingsAdvanceSave
evidence: Verified: descriptor phase, at-most-16-byte payload phase, then header patch. Return active predicate.

name: SettingsSave_BranchTable
evidence: Verified: four targets indexed by active phase at 0x211ee.

name: I2C_ISR_BranchTable

name: I2C_MasterReadBuf

name: I2C_WriteCompleteNoOp

name: CyEnterCriticalSection
evidence: Verified: mrs r0,primask at 0x23a70 and cpsid i at 0x23a74.

name: CyExitCriticalSection
evidence: Verified: msr primask,r0 at 0x23a78.

name: SPC_EnablePower

name: SPC_LoadRowBuffer
evidence: Verified: command sequence b6,d5,02 then array selector and buffer bytes. Inferred descriptive name, original API unknown.

name: SPC_RequestWriteRow
evidence: Verified: command sequence b6,d8,05 then array, row, and two trailing bytes. Inferred descriptive name. Original API and trailing-byte semantics unknown.

name: SPC_TryAcquire
evidence: Verified: guarded lock byte at 0x1fff904c and wait-pipeline bit clear. Return zero or 4. Inferred descriptive name.

name: SPC_Release
